author: Karl Guttag
description:
Last month I attended and participated in MicroLED and AR/VR Connect in Eindhoven. This conference reminds me of the early days of SPIE's AR/VR/MR conference in that it is drawing some excellent speakers and companies while still offering some excellent opportunities to meet and network with people. 

As a sign of the times, it seems many MicroLED companies are now putting an emphasis on optical interconnects and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) for use in AI data centers. 
The one very bright spot is that there seems to be a very big market for audio to visual translation being reported.
title: MicroLED + AR/VR Connect and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO)
